# Indus Valley script research knowledge base

> Source-linked research on the Indus script and its archaeology. Complete object records and metadata are the first priority. The script remains undeciphered.

- [README](README.md): purpose, findings and ways to explore.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): agent rules and task routes.
- [Findings guide](knowledge/findings/README.md): measured results by subject.
- [Working model](knowledge/WORKING-MODEL.md): current claims and deciding tests.
- [Conjectures](knowledge/conjectures/README.md): claims, credences and predictions.
- [Questions](knowledge/questions/): open research and data tasks.
- [Data coverage](knowledge/DATA.md): sources, gaps and priorities.
- [Repository map](knowledge/MAP.md): navigation through the knowledge base.
- [Attempt registry](knowledge/experiments/registry.json): earlier work and retry conditions.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): ownership and review.
- [LOCAL_STORAGE.md](LOCAL_STORAGE.md): local input storage and restoration.
